title: Lion cub holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Balloon string -->
  <path d='M68 42 Q72 50 70 58' stroke='#88DDFF' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <!-- Balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='28' rx='11' ry='14' fill='#FF4466'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='28' rx='11' ry='14' fill='none' stroke='#FF7799' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='23' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#FFAACC' opacity='0.7'/>
  <polygon points='66,42 70,42 68,45' fill='#FF4466'/>
  <!-- Lion body -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='72' rx='18' ry='14' fill='#FFCC33'/>
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='72' rx='18' ry='14' fill='none' stroke='#FFE066' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Front legs -->
  <rect x='32' y='80' width='7' height='10' rx='3' fill='#FFCC33' stroke='#FFE066' stroke-width='1'/>
  <rect x='45' y='80' width='7' height='10' rx='3' fill='#FFCC33' stroke='#FFE066' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- Paws -->
  <ellipse cx='35.5' cy='91' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#FFBB22'/>
  <ellipse cx='48.5' cy='91' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#FFBB22'/>
  <!-- Arm holding balloon -->
  <path d='M52 66 Q60 64 67 58' stroke='#FFCC33' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M52 66 Q60 64 67 58' stroke='#FFE066' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='57' r='3.5' fill='#FFBB22'/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d='M24 74 Q14 70 16 60 Q17 54 22 52' stroke='#FFCC33' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='51' r='4' fill='#FF8844'/>
  <!-- Mane -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='45' r='19' fill='#FF8844'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='45' r='19' fill='none' stroke='#FFAA66' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Mane inner highlights -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='38' r='4' fill='#FF9955'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='38' r='4' fill='#FF9955'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='28' r='4' fill='#FF9955'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='50' r='4' fill='#FF9955'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='50' r='4' fill='#FF9955'/>
  <!-- Face -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='45' r='13' fill='#FFDD77'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='45' r='13' fill='none' stroke='#FFEE99' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <circle cx='31' cy='34' r='5' fill='#FFCC33'/>
  <circle cx='31' cy='34' r='3' fill='#FF9955'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='34' r='5' fill='#FFCC33'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='34' r='3' fill='#FF9955'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='37' cy='42' r='2.5' fill='#332200'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='42' r='2.5' fill='#332200'/>
  <circle cx='37.8' cy='41.2' r='0.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='47.8' cy='41.2' r='0.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='48' rx='2.5' ry='1.8' fill='#CC7744'/>
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d='M39 51 Q42 54 45 51' stroke='#CC7744' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='48' r='2.5' fill='#FFAA77' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='2.5' fill='#FFAA77' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Whiskers -->
  <line x1='28' y1='45' x2='34' y2='46' stroke='#CC9955' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <line x1='28' y1='49' x2='34' y2='48' stroke='#CC9955' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='46' x2='56' y2='45' stroke='#CC9955' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='48' x2='56' y2='49' stroke='#CC9955' stroke-width='0.8'/>
</svg>
